uca_sentences: A man wearing a black hat and blue clothes stood in front of the counter, and a clerk wearing a white apron and black hat stood behind the counter at the cashier.
The clerk wearing a white apron and a black hat clicks on the checkout display to talk to a man wearing a black hat and blue clothes.
The man wearing a black hat and blue clothes took out a pistol and communicated with the store clerk.
The man pointed a gun at the clerk, and the clerk opened the cashier drawer to withdraw money.
The clerk handed the money to the man and the drawer to the man. The man didn't want it, and the clerk put the drawer back.
